content: God will not have his work made manifest by cowards.
author: Ralph Waldo Emerson
explanation: Truth demands bold advocates. Great insights and noble causes require courageous men and women willing to endure criticism, risk, and toil.
practicalInsight: Stand up courageously for what is right today, even if your voice trembles.
reflectionPrompt: What truth or duty are you avoiding out of fear of conflict?
